notes.t110: gpio73=PC9 status LED (0.5s heartbeat); gpio58=PB26 WiFi IRQ; gpio62=PB30 SD-CD active-high; gpio30=PA30 reset button active-low; wlan seq: gpio60=PB28 REGON then gpio61=PB29 pwrseq reset active-low; speaker amp en gpio63. LeCam GPIOHelper set {0,46,49,50,63,73,75}: gpio46=IR LED, gpio49/50=ircut pair, gpio75=white lamp (device has light temperature+intensity profiles) - held in reserve until hardware-verified. MOTORS ARE PWM/TCU (motor.ko, pan maxstep 5300 / elev 1100, coil pins in SMHLROQP table, candidates B8/B9/B17/B18/C15/C18) - NOT GPIO; left unconfigured here pending coil-pin scope work; thingino has no motor.ko ioctl driver class yet.
